energy_levels_source: NIST ASD CuII,III,IV,V ionization tables in round2_references; bracketed CuIV/V values are estimates
rate_model: Lotz valence3d ionization, inverse Maxwellian detailed balance; Kramers-Milne ground-state radiative recombination same approximation as inherited model
limitations: Ground ionic states only; excited ionic lines and dielectronic recombination omitted
Lotz and hydrogenic recombination are semiempirical, not measured charge-resolved cross sections
Cu4+ upper truncation must be checked; Cu4+ ->Cu5+ threshold79.8eV
